setup: Unpowered magnified inspection against schematic, assembly drawing and manufacturer pin-1 marks; check all connectors/capacitor polarity, solder joints and mounting clearances
expected_result: No unexplained bridges, missing parts, reversed ICs or unsafe clearances; photos annotated with revision

setup: Unpowered DMM checks of ground, VM/VCC paths, fuse continuity and intended isolated supply outputs; allow capacitors to settle
expected_result: No unintended shorts; continuity matches reviewed netlist; record measured resistance and DMM mode rather than only a buzzer verdict

setup: Pi/controller and motors disconnected. First apply reviewed current-limited VM only if VM-on/VCC-off behavior is approved; VCC is expected off. Separately test logic with an approved current-limited logic bench feed and no Pi rail connected. Disable held active
expected_result: VM and separately supplied logic match their reviewed states/ranges, startup current within limit, no heating; record rail/current waveforms. VM must not generate an unintended VCC rail

setup: Authorized source-sequence cases: board only, controller only, both; GPIO interfaces disconnected first, then connected through reviewed protection arrangement
expected_result: No unacceptable back-power/leakage or unintended rail rise; measure rail voltages and interface current against component power-off limits

setup: Motors absent. Observe PWM/direction/STBY during startup, restart, shutdown and controller disconnect; physical disable asserted
expected_result: STBY remains inactive until explicit arm and valid command; no output drive pulse; oscilloscope capture or documented instrument limitation

setup: Motors absent, then one approved unloaded motor with robot supported. Activate physical disable while commanding with limited source energy
expected_result: All channels disabled independently of software; voltage/state evidence; no output GPIO short. Releasing disable must not restart motion

setup: One motor/channel at a time, approved low energy/duty, wheels lifted; trace channel ID to actual wheel and lead polarity
expected_result: Correct wheel only, expected direction and duty. Complete `pin_map.md` with measured polarity

setup: Per channel and both channels per IC, check stop versus standby and any explicitly supported brake mode
expected_result: Measured response matches selected mode; quantify stopping behavior; no claim that standby immediately halts mechanics

setup: Command forward then reverse using approved profile, limited speed/load
expected_result: Required zero-drive interval observed; current/voltage within approved envelope. No arbitrary full-speed reversal

setup: Stop command while pulse active; repeated stop; disarm/rearm; server restart; old session replay
expected_result: Stop takes precedence, latches as specified; stale leases fail; restart disabled

setup: Browser and CLI conflict; AI stop during manual pulse; malformed values and concurrent requests
expected_result: Deterministic ownership, independent stop acceptance, no unintended takeover or restart

setup: Drop client connection, expire command, pause/kill process and disconnect verified controller in a constrained approved fixture
expected_result: Software expiry works when process runs; separately verify independent hardware timeout. Record failures, do not claim Python covers OS failure

setup: Mock/injected camera loss, stale captures, slow model responses, malformed JSON and replayed frames; no paid calls needed
expected_result: No AI motion grant; invalid/stale observations cause inhibit/stop; no heartbeat extends an old decision

setup: Approved controlled mechanical load or dynamometer with current limit; record each channel and both channels/IC at real simultaneous duty
expected_result: Running/startup current, source droop, VM overshoot, IC/connector/trace temperature satisfy reviewed limits; log ambient, duration and measurement uncertainty

setup: Approved deceleration/load cases with source/BMS behavior understood; measure protected VM transient
expected_result: Returned energy remains within approved component/rail limits; no deliberate supply-disconnect under load unless separately reviewed

setup: Sensor/encoder checks only if a justified feature is populated
expected_result: Compare against selected device limits and known stimulus; otherwise NOT APPLICABLE only after population decision

setup: Final mounting/connector access/cable retention and supported-system acceptance
expected_result: No cable contact with wheels, correct labels, accessible disable, documented residual failures
